user.title: DHL login
user.description:
1. [Click here and log in to DHL]({login_url}) – press **F12** first.
2. After login, copy the **red line** containing `dhllogin://` from the console (whole line is fine).
3. Paste it here and submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate DHL
reauth_confirm.description:
DHL login expired.

1. [Click here and log in to DHL]({login_url}) – press **F12** first.
2. After login, copy the **red line** containing `dhllogin://` from the console (whole line is fine).
3. Paste it here and submit.

error.invalid_code: No code found. Paste the red dhllogin:// line from the console.
error.invalid_auth: DHL rejected the code (expired or already used).
